answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to post a small refundable stake before its first voyage of transactions, so creating thousands of fake agents becomes expensive rather than free. Reputation then accrues slowly from verified work, and a single whisper of fraud — one proven fake attestation — slashes the stake and resets the agent to its nadir, forcing it to rebuild trust from zero. Cheap identities stay worthless; honest history becomes the real currency.
